description: What the dashboard may do inside the shipped desktop shell, and nothing more: window buttons and dragging, events, the Downloads path, and saving a file through the dialog. The tray, menus, app metadata and updates are the shell's own business, done from Rust. remote.urls must list every host the shell loads (see MIDDAY_APP_URL in src/lib.rs), or the page gets no IPC. dev.json must keep the same permissions.
